title: Auth0 authentication flows (paraphrase)
text: Auth0 documents the authorization code flow with PKCE for single-page and native applications. Token lifetimes, including ID token and refresh token expiration, are configurable in the dashboard. Auth0 publishes a free plan; its user limits are listed on the pricing page and can change.
